_comment: Realistic mock of a single Google Trends observation after normalisation by GoogleTrendsProducer._build_raw_payload(). This dict is stored verbatim as raw_payload inside the Bronze envelope. Represents a STATIC mode observation for keyword='Inflation' in the US geo, at trending rank 5 on 2026-04-02. interest_score is derived from rank-to-100 formula: max(0.0, 100.0 - (rank_index * 2.0)) = max(0.0, 100.0 - (4 * 2.0)) = 92.0. Section 4.4 / Section C.1 / Section B.5.
